stem: Select TWO practices that match this workbook's lab safety rules.

choices.text: Store access keys in the React bundle for convenience
Treat budget alerts as lagging signals, not spend stoppers
Assume Free Tier will cover all lab hours
Let agents execute apply/destroy in your account
Run teardown deletes when finished or stopping early

rationale: Teardown is mandatory; budgets alert only. Keys stay out of the app; Free Tier is never assumed; agents never touch AWS.
